endings.name: Under the Door
endings.summary: You slide the truth under six doors. The guests learn they were gathered on purpose and leave together before dawn; the mercenary goes the other way alone. You are left in the passage when the knock comes.

endings.name: The Wrong Picture
endings.summary: Your deductions are mostly wrong and the file is believed. At dawn a guest who did not do what you wrote is led out through the lobby.

endings.name: The Open Door
endings.summary: You answer the 2:14 knock and walk out with the stranger. Nobody logs the last night, and the guest you watched most does not come back.

endings.name: The Next Watcher
endings.summary: You keep logging with an accurate hand. The file is complete, every guest is sold as predicted, and next season a new watcher's lens looks in on you.
